units.source_text: ……也许会有人根据上面的记述，立即断定我是个有诗人气质的少年。

en.t: ... Perhaps, based on the description above, some people would immediately conclude that I was a boy with the temperament of a poet.

units.source_text: 然而，别说诗了，就连笔记一类东西，迄今我也没有写过。

en.t: However, far from writing poetry, I had never even written anything like notes up to that time.

units.source_text: 我缺乏一种冲动，即一种用别的能力来弥补我不如他人的能力，以此达到超群出众的冲动。

en.t: I lacked a certain impulse: the impulse to make up for abilities in which I was inferior to others by means of some other ability, and thereby become outstanding.

units.source_text: 换句话说，我要当艺术家，未免太傲慢了。

en.t: In other words, it would have been far too arrogant of me to try to become an artist.

units.source_text: 我梦想当暴君或艺术家，然而仅仅停留在梦想，压根儿就无意着手干点什么实事。

en.t: I dreamed of becoming a tyrant or an artist, but it remained no more than a dream; I had no intention at all of setting my hand to anything real.
